messages:
pat: FYI we're seeing elevated timeouts and 504s for private deployments in eu-north-1 starting ~22:13 UTC. intermittent client connections are failing at the egress layer. opening an incident thread. https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1865256789
zoe: oncall responding. initial telemetry shows sustained packet drops on the primary ISP egress path causing high TCP retransmits. enabled local egress fallback routing to the secondary peer and increased connection timeouts for internal clients. error rate dropped from ~9% -> ~1.8%.
mike: digging into host metrics  NAT gateway queues are saturated, p95 conn wait up x6. applied `sysctl net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range="15000 61000"` and bumped `conntrack_max`. restarted `nat-proxy` on nat-01 and nat-02. seeing backlog drain.
net-bot: provider-notice: ISP reported partial maintenance impacting egress peering (ticket ISP-99421). ETA unknown. link: https://isp.status/99421
support: notified 5 affected private-deployment customers with holding language: "Were seeing transient network egress issues in eu-north-1 affecting private deployments. We've enabled a fallback egress path and applied mitigations. We'll follow up with a timeline and RCA."
infra: long-term mitigation in progress: provisioning transit-gateway fallback and route reweighting to shift steady-state traffic off the affected peer. Starting rollout in eu-north-1 (batch 1/2). CI: https://ci.redwood/build/8457
zoe: mitigation checklist: 1) enable fallback peer (done), 2) increase client timeouts (done), 3) adjust host conn limits (done), 4) restart nat-proxy on affected hosts (done), 5) provision transit-gateway fallback (in progress), 6) customer outreach (done). status doc: https://go.redwood/incident/1865256789
mike: note: watch for cold-cache storm while traffic shifts to fallback path (KV cache miss rate could temporarily rise). I've placed a short cache-warm window and increased read-retries for 10m.
zoe: severity set to SEV2 given customer impact. keep thread open until 95th percentile tail latency and 504 rates are back to baseline for 60 minutes. assigning postmortem owners: zoe (RCA), infra (network follow-ups), support (customer timeline). Please react with :loud_sound: if you see regressions.
